parameters.name: include

schema.description: Optional enrichment fields to include on each face item. Repeatable or comma-separated. Recognized values: 'tags', 'teams', 'profile', 'sharing', 'avatar'. 'avatar' populates `avatar_status` and `avatar_uploaded` (`avatar_status` is one of 'none', 'current' or 'stale'), so a client can show a refresh affordance without a request per face. It is opt-in because deciding it reads the compiled-profile rows, which a bare listing does not fetch. 'sharing' populates `shared_with`, which is otherwise present but always empty on this route: it is the only way to see who a face is shared with in a listing. 'owner_follow' populates `owner_followed` (whether YOU follow each row's owner), so a wall of badges can style a Follow button per creator without fetching your whole following list first. Null on your own faces. 'owner_avatar' populates `owner_avatar`: whether the row's owner's `me` face has a REAL picture rather than the placeholder, so a badge fetches /v1/faces/{owned_by}:me/avatar only for the creators who have one and draws the placeholder locally for the rest. Unknown values are silently ignored. The face description is always included; tags, teams, and the compiled-profile fields (component_counts, compile_tokens_synced, last_synced_at) are populated only when requested here, and returned as null otherwise.
